# moodle_quiz_question (Resource)

Adds a question to a Moodle quiz.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "moodle_quiz_question" "capital_city" {
  course_id     = moodle_course.example.id
  quiz_id       = moodle_quiz.midterm.id
  name          = "Capital of France"
  type          = "multichoice"
  question_text = "What is the capital city of France?"

  choice {
    answer   = "Paris"
    grade    = 1.0
    feedback = "Correct!"
  }

  choice {
    answer   = "London"
    grade    = 0.0
    feedback = "London is the capital of the United Kingdom."
  }

  choice {
    answer   = "Berlin"
    grade    = 0.0
    feedback = "Berlin is the capital of Germany."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `course_id` (Number) The ID of the course containing the quiz.
- `name` (String) The display name of the question.
- `question_text` (String) The HTML text of the question displayed to the student.
- `quiz_id` (Number) The ID of the quiz to add the question to.
- `type` (String) The question type. Supported: 'multichoice'.

### Optional

- `choice` (Block List) Answer choice block. At least 2 choices are required for multichoice questions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--choice))
- `page` (Number) The page number on which the question appears. Default: 0.
- `slot` (Number) The slot position of the question in the quiz.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The question ID.

<a id="nestedblock--choice"></a>
### Nested Schema for `choice`

Required:

- `answer` (String) The answer text.
- `feedback` (String) Feedback shown when this choice is selected.
- `grade` (Number) The grade for this choice (0.0 = incorrect, 1.0 = full credit). Supports partial credit values.
